symptom: Cannot connect to Wi-Fi, no internet, network disconnected

steps.instruction: Confirm Wi-Fi toggle is switched On and Airplane mode is turned Off.
steps.expected_observation: The list of available company networks appears in network settings.

steps.instruction: Check whether other team members or your secondary approved mobile device can connect to the SSID.
steps.expected_observation: Identifies whether the issue is isolated to your computer or office-wide.

steps.instruction: Disconnect from the company Wi-Fi network (Corp-Secure), wait 10 seconds, and reconnect.
steps.expected_observation: Device attempts DHCP authentication and requests an IP address.

steps.instruction: Restart your device if permitted by current IT compliance policy.
steps.expected_observation: System restarts and reinitializes network interfaces.

steps.instruction: If the issue continues, record the exact error code or prompt and contact IT Support.
steps.expected_observation: Documented error code available for ticket creation.

Check whether other team members or your secondary approved mobile device can connect to the SSID. Disconnect from the company Wi-Fi network (Corp-Secure), wait 10 seconds, and reconnect. Restart your device if permitted by current IT compliance policy. If the issue continues, record the exact error code or prompt and contact IT Support.

symptom: Windows limited connectivity, yellow triangle, DNS failure

steps.instruction: Open Settings > Network & Internet > Advanced network settings > Network reset.
steps.expected_observation: Windows resets network adapters and prompts for a restart within 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Open Command Prompt and run `ipconfig /flushdns` followed by `ipconfig /renew`.
steps.expected_observation: DNS cache is cleared and a fresh DHCP lease IP (10.x.x.x) is assigned.

steps.instruction: Verify your wireless adapter in Device Manager shows 'This device is working properly'.
steps.expected_observation: No yellow exclamation mark or error code 43 on the adapter.

Open Command Prompt and run `ipconfig /flushdns` followed by `ipconfig /renew`. Verify your wireless adapter in Device Manager shows 'This device is working properly'.

symptom: macOS Wi-Fi no IP address, self-assigned IP 169.254, dropping connection

steps.instruction: Hold the Option key and click the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar to review BSSID, RSSI, and channel noise.
steps.expected_observation: RSSI should be stronger than -70 dBm for stable connection.

steps.instruction: Go to System Settings > Wi-Fi > Details > TCP/IP and click 'Renew DHCP Lease'.
steps.expected_observation: IPv4 address refreshes from 169.254.x.x to corporate subnet 10.x.x.x.

steps.instruction: Remove the corporate network from Known Networks, then rejoin entering your SSO credentials.
steps.expected_observation: Prompts for 802.1X enterprise certificate validation.

symptom: Printer offline, printer not responding, cannot discover printer

steps.instruction: Confirm the physical printer is powered on and the front LCD panel displays 'Ready' with no flashing error lights.
steps.expected_observation: Green power indicator is solid and paper trays are seated.

steps.instruction: Verify that your computer and the printer are on the same approved corporate network or VLAN.
steps.expected_observation: Cannot print across guest networks or external VPN tunnels.

steps.instruction: Open Printers & Scanners on your computer and verify the designated floor printer is selected as Default.
steps.expected_observation: Default printer name matches the asset tag on your office floor.

steps.instruction: Send a small single-page test document to verify spooling.
steps.expected_observation: Printer displays 'Receiving Data' and prints test page.

topic: Stuck Print Spooler and Paper Jams
symptom: Print job stuck in queue, paper jam, spooler service error

steps.instruction: Open your print queue and cancel only your own pending print jobs; do not delete other users' jobs.
steps.expected_observation: The queue clears within 30 seconds.

steps.instruction: Check all physical paper trays, side doors, and output bins for crumpled or stuck sheets.
steps.expected_observation: Any trapped paper is removed gently along the paper path without tearing.

steps.instruction: Power-cycle the printer by pressing the power switch, waiting 30 seconds, and turning it back on.
steps.expected_observation: Printer runs internal diagnostic calibration and displays Ready.

symptom: Windows spooler stopped, error 0x0000011b, printer driver error

steps.instruction: Press Win+R, type `services.msc`, locate 'Print Spooler', and click Restart Service.
steps.expected_observation: Windows spooler service restarts and clears hanging locks.

steps.instruction: In Windows Settings > Bluetooth & Devices > Printers, select printer and run 'Run the troubleshooter'.
steps.expected_observation: Windows detects port conflicts and repairs communication.

symptom: macOS printer paused, Filter failed error, CUPS queue halt

steps.instruction: Open System Settings > Printers & Scanners, right-click the printer list, and choose 'Reset Printing System'.
steps.expected_observation: Clears corrupted print queues and daemon state.

steps.instruction: Re-add the printer using AirPrint or Secure IPP with the corporate printer DNS name.
steps.expected_observation: macOS downloads verified vendor PPD profile.

section: SECTION 3: Email and Email Client Problems
symptom: Cannot send email, cannot receive email, Outlook disconnected, sync error

steps.instruction: Check the company IT service status portal or webmail to verify cloud mail servers are operational.
steps.expected_observation: Confirms whether mail service is operational for your organization.

steps.instruction: Open the approved Webmail portal (outlook.office.com or webmail.company.com) in your browser.
steps.expected_observation: Verifies your account credentials and mailbox access independently of the desktop client.

steps.instruction: Verify network connection and check the status bar at the bottom of Outlook.
steps.expected_observation: Status bar displays 'Connected to Microsoft Exchange' instead of 'Disconnected' or 'Need Password'.

steps.instruction: Check your Outbox folder for any oversized email attachments (exceeding 25MB) that may block the queue.
steps.expected_observation: Moving or deleting oversized draft restores normal outgoing transmission.

steps.instruction: Record any exact bounce-back code (e.g. NDR 550 5.1.1) without including passwords or authentication codes.
steps.expected_observation: Error code saved for escalation.

section: SECTION 3: Email and Email Client Problems
symptom: Outlook crashes on startup, profile corrupted, OST synchronization error

steps.instruction: Launch Outlook in Safe Mode by holding Ctrl while clicking the Outlook shortcut, or run `outlook.exe /safe`.
steps.expected_observation: Outlook opens with all third-party add-ins disabled.

steps.instruction: In Control Panel > Mail > Data Files, select your data file and run the Inbox Repair Tool (scanpst.exe).
steps.expected_observation: Scans OST file for internal corruption and repairs headers.

topic: macOS Outlook and Apple Mail Troubleshooting
symptom: macOS Outlook constantly prompting for credentials, Apple Mail offline

steps.instruction: Open Keychain Access, search for 'Exchange' and 'Office', and delete old cached tokens.
steps.expected_observation: Next launch triggers a fresh Microsoft Modern Authentication SSO prompt.

steps.instruction: In Outlook menu, click Tools > Accounts > Advanced > Empty Cache.
steps.expected_observation: Outlook re-synchronizes folders from the Exchange server.
